Subject: SOC2 renewal: retention horizon change (12 -> 18 months) and evidence ask

Connor —

Quick summary: Skylark's renewal is scheduled for 2026-06-01 and our internal compliance team (and external auditors) are asking us to increase the log retention horizon from 12 months to 18 months as a condition of renewal. That affects retention of auth/event logs, request traces, and system audit trails.

Can Redwood confirm:
- Whether you can extend the retention window to 18 months for our subscription (SKY-2026-0042) across all regions (we primarily run US).
- The STS for exporting logs (S3 export / syslog / API access) and whether there's an agreed SLA for the export job window.
- Expected cost or seat/billing impact if we need to store + index an additional 6 months of logs.

AuditOps (cc'd) will want an evidence bundle for the last 12 months and a plan for the additional 6 months (how it will be stored, access controls, and proof of tamper-evidence). Can you also provide a mapping of where the audit logs live and an inventory spreadsheet?

We're aiming to have the compliance package to auditors by 2026-05-10 to keep the renewal process on track.

Thanks — can you loop in anyone on your side who owns log export and capacity planning?

Erin Mills
Director, Risk & Compliance
Skylark Finance

Team / Erin —

Thanks — I ran a quick pricing model based on the retention uplift. Options for Skylark:
A) Hosted: pay-as-you-go storage + egress. Ballpark: $0.023 / GB / month for hot storage, $0.008 / GB / month for archival; 1.5x egress multiplier for bulk export jobs. Estimated run-rate increase: ~28% as Kim noted.
B) Dedicated: reserved commit for storage (12/24 month) + discounted egress and the ability to enable archival compression. Upfront commit gets you ~15% unit discount.
C) Hybrid: keep hot 12-months on hosted + 6-months archived in a lower-cost tier with retrieval-on-demand (compromise for auditors).

If Skylark signs a 12-month reserved capacity add-on for dedicated retention we can include a one-time credit for the export job and a 10% onboarding discount (deal id SKY-2026-0042).

Next step: Erin, can you confirm a target budget or whether procurement wants a formal SOW/PO? If you confirm committed seats or a term, I can produce pricing + DocuSign by EOD Monday.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
